'''''Intense Performer''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[entertainer]] [[Anj'a]] performing her number one galactic hit "[[Booombaaa Boombaa Bombashella]]" at the [[Grand Theater of Vreni Island|outdoor theater]] on [[Vreni Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], copies of the painting were given out by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Matilda Carson]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to any and all who asked for one.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Intense Performer'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' as a painting the player could use to decorate their home. The painting's artwork also appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' expansion set ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' as an "Ability" card called ''Intense Performer''. It was added to the games in [[2010]] as part of a contest for players to have their artwork and its description added to the games. Intense Performer's artist is a player known as Anj'a. Only the painting's artwork appeared in ''Threat of the Conqueror'' while a description of the painting appeared along with it in ''Star Wars Galaxies''.
